name: Sepulcro-Hilario (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and green with a broad white stripe, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Sepulcro-Hilario (a crozier on red and trees on white).
history: The arms of Sepulcro-Hilario were published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado on 15 April 1998; the municipal flag was approved on 31 July 1998 and is of silver with the council's own arms over all.
